rina: Quick sync - bringing Cassiopeia14b (int4) online in dedicated. Running into sporadic tail OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 350 + bursty concurrency.

sam: Can you repro on a canary? any slotstats or frag numbers?

rina: Yes repro on canary under synthetic bursts. Snapshot: active_slots=60 free_slots=4 frag_ratio=0.44 after ~6 long-gen sessions. Logs show cudaMalloc fail.

jules: Sounds like allocation churn + prefetch gap holes. Two immediate levers: lower default max_new_tokens to 150 for initial rollout; set kv_prefetch=false; enable slot_compactor with short aggressive window. Also reduce per-worker batch_limit to 6.

kai: Agree. Also propose a runtime probe: implement an "evict-before-alloc" fast-path for large single allocs (>200MB) to try preemptive eviction of cold slots before triggering GC. Metricize hits and success.

rina: failing log snippet from canary node-4:
```
[2024-08-13T08:22:10Z] req=rid-202 model=cassiopeia14b int4 seq_len=512 max_new=512
alloc error: cudaMalloc OOM
kv_cache: reserved=1.88GB active=60 free=4 frag=0.44
GC reclaimed 40MB -> still OOM
```

sam: frag 0.44 is pretty high. Proposed canary config (YAML):
route: cassiopeia-14b-int4-canary
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 150
  batch_limit: 6
  kv_prefetch: false
  slot_compactor: aggressive
  warmstart_reserve_mb: 300
  slo_fallback: cassiopeia14b-int8-safe

jules: +1. Also add an SLO rule: if OOM_rate > 0.3% over 5m, route to fallback. And run the eval harness on canary outputs (5k prompts) to catch any quality regressions from the int4 variant. If generation-quality delta >2% we rollback.

rina: deploying canary now and will run 10m at 2x production QPS, then run eval.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route cassiopeia-14b-int4-canary by rina at 2024-08-13T08:28:05Z :rocket:

sam: When running load capture `nvidia-smi` + `slotstats` every 30s. If compactor reduces frag to <0.2 and OOMs are zero we can consider making kv_prefetch=false permanent.

rina: 6m in: zero OOMs, p95 latency +4% vs baseline. slotstats show frag_ratio -> 0.16 after compaction.

kai: Nice. Run eval and compute RL/QA deltas. If small, plan staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> full.

jules: Filing tiny runtime PR to add `evict-before-alloc` probe (opt-in flag) so we can A/B it on canaries. If it reduces compaction frequency, we can relax aggressive compactor.

rina: Eval results: 5k prompts, BLEU/RL proxies show 1.1% avg delta vs baseline on int8 reference. Under 2% threshold. Passing.

deploy-bot: Canary passed smoke + eval checks at 2024-08-13T08:41:30Z.

sam: Proceed with staged ramp to 20% for 30m. Watch OOM_rate, tail latency, and quality metrics. If OOMs reappear, enable evict-before-alloc on the route.

rina: Kicked staged rollout. Will post monitoring snapshots in 30m. Thanks team :heart:

jules: Follow-up items: dashboard preemptive-evict hit-rate, per-request alloc-size histogram, and alert if frag_ratio >0.3 for >10m. I'll add RFC for evict-before-alloc behaviour and heuristics.

sam: Also consider dynamic warmstart_reserve tuning based on median gen length per-model later.

rina: Noted. Closing loop after staged ramp.

deploy-bot: Staged rollout to 20% started at 2024-08-13T09:00:12Z.
